name: Micheliel Travers
original_name: ミケリエール・トラヴェルザ
source:
The king of the world in which [url=/c13003]Nike[/url] and [url=/c11793]Ryu[/url] live. Although he looks like a child, Micheliel actually had been living for 33 generations.
Mikeliel is one of the few people whom Rijurel, his minister, actually likes and can talk with in ease.

[Translated from [url=http://sunset77light.rdy.jp/041/t-base.html]Yuuakari's site[/url].]
